title: Release Apache Iceberg 1.12.0 RC2
summary: nssalian proposed release candidate 2 (commit 212aa894, tag apache-iceberg-1.12.0-rc2) as Apache Iceberg 1.12.0, with voting open until September 29, 2026, 2:00 pm Pacific. Voters verified signatures, checksums, licenses, builds and tests. huaxingao noticed that no Spark 4.2 artifacts were staged because dev/stage-binaries.sh lists only Spark 3.5, 4.0 and 4.1, and suggested another RC; amogh-jahagirdar initially agreed. nssalian and RussellSpitzer pointed out that PR #18024 had excluded 4.2 from convenience binaries on purpose, and amogh-jahagirdar found the earlier thread explaining that 4.2 development continues but is not released because Spark APIs were still evolving. huaxingao withdrew the concern and voted +1, confirming that the LICENSE findings from RC1 and the variant NoSuchMethodError were fixed. The bundle contains no result message.

positions.stance: Raised that Spark 4.2 artifacts were missing from staging and another RC might be needed, then withdrew the concern after recalling that 4.2 was intentionally not released.
Asked for clarification before cutting another RC, citing the review comment on the Spark 4.2 PR about 4.2 support in 1.12.
PR #18024 explicitly excluded Spark 4.2 from convenience binaries, and the staged artifacts are good excluding 4.2 as expected.
Excluding Spark 4.2 was intentional so development could continue while its release was in doubt due to evolving Spark APIs.

outcome.note: No result message is in the thread. The messages show +1 votes only: one marked binding (RussellSpitzer) and nine marked non-binding; no -1 votes.

why_it_matters: Iceberg 1.12.0 ships Spark 4.2 source but deliberately no Spark 4.2 convenience binaries.
